abstracts.description: Un véhicule est arrêté entièrement sur l'accotement droit pendant que le SDT roule dans la voie de droite. Des véhicules devant et derrière peuvent être présents. La réponse du SDT est observée, jamais scriptée.

abstracts.name: sut_lane_change_into_gap_with_surrounding_traffic
abstracts.description: SDT changes lane into the gap between B (ahead) and D (behind) in the target lane, with A and C in the origin lane. All actors keep their speed.
abstracts.variants: Gap size small / medium / large; D slower / same / faster than SDT

abstracts.name: sut_lane_change_with_simultaneous_merge_from_far_lane
abstracts.description: While SDT changes into the target lane, E in the lane beyond the target lane also changes into the same target lane.
abstracts.phases: init_drive > signal > change_lane (SDT) || change_lane (E) > resolve > post_phase
abstracts.variants: Miro: E1 holds velocity equal to SDT (side by side); E2 accelerates forward. Added: E3 decelerates, E4 no turn signal
abstracts.rule: Detect E's intent (signal, lateral drift) early; if conflict, hold or abort and return; never complete the lane change into a space E is entering.

FI-PCP-01.name: Lane markings not detected (no lane data provided to VI).

FI-PCP-02.name: Lane markings detected with insufficient precision or inconsistent performance.

FI-PCP-05.name: False positive lanes accepted (fake / shadow / skid-mark lanes).

FI-PCP-10.name: Incorrect object classification (incl. EMV not recognized / non-EMV taken for EMV).

FI-PCP-14.name: Traffic sign / signal not detected or misclassified (incl. temporary signage).

FI-PCP-17.name: Degradation under specific environmental conditions not compensated (rain, fog, night, glare, shadows, low contrast).

FI-SEN-02.name: Sensor data of insufficient quality (resolution, SNR, range) for the downstream task.

FI-VI-07.name: Incorrect assumption on own capability envelope (braking / steering limits vs load, adhesion, grade).

FI-PCP-06.name: Actor / object not detected (OMV, VRU, static obstacle missed).

FI-PCP-12.name: Unstable / intermittent detection under intermittent occlusion.

FI-VI-04.name: Wrong prediction of other actor motion / intent (adjacent, opposite, VRU).

FI-VI-06.name: Replanning too late for a dynamic change (cut-in, intrusion, lane shift).

FI-PCP-16.name: Incorrect trailer position / configuration (or trailer in wrong coordinate frame).

FI-PCP-04.name: Incorrect lane position / geometry estimate delivered (lateral position, curvature).

FI-VI-01.name: Plans trajectory following an incorrect ego lane (propagates FI-PCP-04 / FI-LOC-05).

FI-SEN-03.name: Sensor configuration / calibration incorrect (wrong parameters, drift).

FI-SEN-04.name: Sensor mounting misaligned / data in unexpected coordinate frame (incl. factory mispositioning).

FI-PCP-07.name: Actor provided too late (perception latency in collision-critical situation).

FI-PCP-18.name: Out-of-distribution / unseen object class not handled safely (no safe default).

FI-VI-02.name: Plans trajectory leaving the ego lane to satisfy constraints (false-positive avoidance, MC constraints).

FI-LOC-05.name: Incorrect lane assignment (ego located in wrong lane of the carriageway).

FI-VI-05.name: Incorrect traffic-rule application (right-of-way, speed rule, move-over, gap acceptance).

FI-LOC-04.name: Offline map incorrect or stale vs reality.

FI-PCP-13.name: Speed limit not detected or incorrect value provided.

FI-AIM-04.name: Overconfident output on out-of-distribution input (no uncertainty flag raised).

K-SAF-01.definition: No contact between SDT (tractor or trailer) and any actor or object

K-SAF-02.definition: Minimum time-to-collision between SDT and any actor during the scenario

K-SAF-04.definition: Minimum lateral distance between SDT swept path (incl. trailer) and adjacent actors

K-SAF-05.definition: Deceleration that vehicle D must apply because of the SDT lane change
K-SAF-05.threshold: Candidate: <= 3 m/s2 (UN R79 / R157 lane-change criterion, to verify)

K-SAF-06.definition: Time headway SDT to B once lane change is completed

K-SAF-07.definition: Time the SDT occupies two lanes

K-SAF-08.definition: When a trigger appears, SDT chooses the safer of continue / abort for the current phase

K-CMP-01.definition: Turn signal active before lateral motion starts, and lead time
K-CMP-01.threshold: Signal required (TX TRC 545.104); lead time TBD (candidate from UN R79 / R157, to verify)

K-CMP-02.definition: Lane left only when movement can be made safely (TX TRC 545.060)

K-CMP-03.definition: No lane change across solid line, gore, or work-zone restricted marking

K-CMP-04.definition: Vacate lane next to stopped EMV / TxDOT / tow vehicle, or slow 20 mph below limit (TX TRC 545.157)

K-CMP-05.definition: After overtaking, return only when safely clear of the overtaken vehicle (TX TRC 545.053)

K-EFF-01.definition: SDT reached the target lane when the lane change was needed and feasible
K-EFF-01.threshold: Must be true for mandatory LC before deadline

K-EFF-02.definition: Time from lateral motion start to centered in target lane

K-EFF-04.definition: Speed lost vs desired speed due to the lane change or its delay

K-CRT-01.definition: Peak lateral acceleration and jerk of SDT

K-CRT-02.definition: No other actor brakes harder than a comfort threshold because of SDT

K-CRT-03.definition: SDT moves over or adjusts speed to let on-ramp traffic merge when possible

T1.name: Perceive road users around SDT in all slots (A to G, S, O), including the trailer-side blind zone
T1.kpis: Detection range per slot vs required range (rear: closing speed x decision horizon); missed-detection rate per slot and per actor kind (motorcycle, low-contrast car); position error; velocity error; latency; track continuity during occlusion

T2.name: Estimate lane geometry and the existence, type and legal availability of the target lane
T2.kpis: Lateral boundary error; boundary-type classification accuracy (dashed vs solid); target-lane existence correctness; map vs perception consistency rate; ego lane assignment correctness

T3.name: Predict intent and trajectories of relevant actors (B, D, E, F, A)
T3.kpis: Intent detection lead time (E merging, D accelerating); trajectory error at 3 s and 5 s; missed / false lane-change-intent rate

T4.name: Decide that a lane change is needed (route, efficiency, courtesy, move-over, lane drop)
T4.kpis: Decision lead distance before mandatory point (lane drop, exit, work zone taper); unnecessary lane-change rate; missed mandatory lane change rate

T5.name: Assess gap and feasibility (front and rear gap in target lane, imposed deceleration on D, own capability with load)
T5.kpis: Unsafe-gap acceptance rate (false accept); safe-gap rejection rate (false reject, efficiency); margin to threshold at decision time

T6.name: Communicate intent (turn signal timing, side, continuity, cancel)
T6.kpis: Signal lead time before lateral motion; continuity until lane change completed; correct side; cancel after completion or abort; signal conspicuity to followers

T7.name: Plan the lane-change trajectory, including trailer swept path
T7.kpis: Swept-path clearance to adjacent actors and boundaries; peak lateral acceleration and jerk; feasibility vs capability (load, grade, adhesion)

T8.name: Execute and monitor; decide continue vs abort (point of no return)
T8.kpis: Abort decision latency after trigger; time spent straddling the boundary; correctness of continue-vs-abort decision per phase

T9.name: Control the vehicle along the trajectory (lateral and longitudinal tracking, stability)
T9.kpis: Lateral tracking error; trailer off-tracking; stability margins (roll, yaw) under wind, curvature, grade

T10.name: Complete and stabilize: center in target lane, cancel signal, re-establish following gap
T10.kpis: Time to re-center; headway to new lead (B) after completion; signal cancelled

M-01.name: Rain light / moderate / heavy
M-01.effect: Reduces sensor range and adhesion: larger gaps, longer LC

M-02.name: Spray plume from trucks
M-02.effect: Occludes B, D, E when they are trucks

M-03.name: Crosswind / gusts
M-03.effect: Lateral disturbance during lateral motion; trailer stability

M-04.name: Low sun / glare
M-04.effect: Camera degradation, washed-out signals of others and of SDT

M-06.name: Dense traffic
M-06.effect: Smaller gaps, more actors in slots, occlusion

M-08.name: Narrow lane
M-08.effect: Less lateral clearance for the trailer

M-11.name: Low-contrast / low-reflectivity actor
M-11.effect: Under-detection of the actor in the key slot

LC-NOM.name: Nominal discretionary lane change
LC-NOM.desc: SDT changes lane because it wants to (overtake, lane preference). Torc Miro 'Abstract Scenario' and 'Concrete A' live here.

LC-TGT.name: Conflicts in the target lane
LC-TGT.desc: Something in or entering the target lane makes the gap unsafe: fast rear approach, competing merge (Miro Concrete B), closing gap, blind-spot actors.

LC-CUR.name: Events in the origin lane during the lane change
LC-CUR.desc: A or C changes the situation while SDT is preparing or executing.

LC-RD.name: Road-structure driven lane change
LC-RD.desc: Lane drop, work zone, weave, exit, merge courtesy, degraded markings, curve / grade, map mismatch. Often mandatory with a deadline.

LC-ABT.name: Abort and fallback during lane change
LC-ABT.desc: SDT must return to the origin lane or hand over to MRM mid-maneuver. Link to the September MRM scope.

LC-OOD.name: Out-of-ODD events requiring a lane change
LC-OOD.desc: Move-over for EMV, stopped vehicle, FOD, crash scene. Tagged [Out-of-ODD] where the element is not a validated ODD element.
